1: Allah, jo paak hai, subah ki qasam khata hai,
2: aur Zul-Hijjah ki pehli das raaton ki qasam khata hai,
3: aur cheezon ke taaq aur juft hone ki qasam khata hai,
4: aur raat ki qasam khata hai jab woh aati hai, thehrti hai aur chali jaati hai. In qasmon ka jawab yeh hai: tumhein tumhare aamaal ka badla zaroor diya jayega.
5: In mein se kisi mein bhi koi aisi qasam hai jo aql wale ko faida de?
6: Aey Rasool ﷺ, kya aap ne nahin dekha ke aap ke Rubb ne Aad ke saath kya kiya, yani Hud (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ke saath, jab unhon ne apne Rasool ko jhutlaya?
7: Aad ka qabeela, jo apne buzurg, lambe qad wale Iram ki taraf nisbat rakhta tha,
8: jis jaisa Allah ne shehron mein kabhi koi paida na kiya.
9: Aur kya aap ne nahin dekha ke aap ke Rubb ne Samood ke saath kya kiya, yani Saleh (alaihis salaam) ke qabeele ke saath, jo pahaaron ke patthar taraash kar un se ghar banate thay?
10: Aur kya aap ne nahin dekha ke aap ke Rubb ne Firaun ke saath kya kiya, jis ke paas woh khoonte thay jin se woh logon ko azaab deta tha?
11: In sab logon ne sarkashi aur zulm mein hadd se barh kar kaam kiya; har ek ne apni sarzameen mein hadd se barh kar kaam kiya,
12: aur unhon ne kufr aur gunah phailane ki wajah se bahut fasaad barpa kiya.
13: Pas Allah ne unhein apna sakht azaab chakhaya aur unhein zameen se mita diya.
14: Aey Rasool ﷺ, beshak aap ka Rubb logon ke aamaal ki nigrani aur nigehbani karta hai, taake jo bhalai kare usey jannat ka badla de aur jo buraai kare usey jahannum ka.
15: Allah ne jin qaumon ko halak kiya, unhein quwwat aur taaqat ki niyamat mili thi. Is liye Allah wazeh karta hai ke aisi niyamat dena us ki razamandi ki daleel nahin. Woh farmata hai: insan ki fitrat mein hai ke jab us ka Rubb usey aazmaye aur maal, izzat aur aulad de kar us par ehsan kare, to woh samajhta hai ke yeh Allah ke nazdeek us ki buzurgi ki wajah se hai. Woh kehta hai: “Mere Rubb ne mujh par ehsan kiya, kyunke main is ka haqdar hoon.”
16: Aur jab Allah usey rizq tang kar ke aazmata hai, to woh samajhta hai ke yeh apne Rubb ke nazdeek us ki be-qadri ki wajah se hai. Pas woh kehta hai: “Mere Rubb ne mujhe zaleel kiya.”
17: Hargiz nahin! Maamla waisa nahin jaisa yeh insan samajhta hai, ke niyamat dena Allah ki razamandi ki daleel hai aur tangi bande ki be-qadri ki daleel. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum us rizq mein se yateem ke saath sakhawat nahin karte jo Allah ne tumhein diya.
18: Aur tum mein se koi doosre ko us muhtaj ko khana khilane ki targheeb nahin deta jisey khane ko kuch nahin milta.
19: Tum kamzoron, yani auraton aur yateemon, ke haqq ko be-dhark kha jaate ho, is ki halal hone ki parwa kiye bagair.
20: Aur tum maal se shiddat se mohabbat karte ho, aur us ki hawas ki wajah se usey Allah ke raaste mein kharch karne se bakheeli karte ho.
21: Yeh kaam tumhein laiq nahin. Woh waqt yaad karo jab zameen ko zor se chalaya aur hilaya jayega,
22: aur aey Rasool ﷺ, aap ka Rubb apne bandon ke darmiyan faisla karne ke liye aayega, aur farishte bhi saf bandh kar aayenge.
23: Aur us din jahannum laayi jayegi, jis ke sattar hazaar lagaam honge, aur har lagaam ko sattar hazaar farishte kheench rahe honge. Us din insan ko Allah ke haqq mein apni kotahiyan yaad aayengi, magar us din woh yaad usey zara bhi faida na degi, kyunke woh badle ka din hoga, amal ka nahin.
24: Woh shiddat ke afsos se kahega: “Kaash maine apni aakhirat ki zindagi ke liye, jo asal zindagi hai, neik aamaal aage bhej diye hote!”
25: Us din koi aisi saza na dega jaisi Allah ki saza hogi, kyunke Allah ki saza sab se sakht aur baaqi rehne wali hai,
26: aur koi aise zanjeeron mein na jakrega jaise woh kafiron ko zanjeeron mein jakrega.
27: Allah ne kafiron ka badla bayan kiya, phir mominon ka badla bayan karta hai. Woh farmata hai: momin ki rooh se maut ke waqt aur qayamat ke din kaha jayega: “Aey woh jaan jo iman aur neik aamaal par mutmain hai!”
28: “Apne Rubb ki taraf laut aa, us se raazi ho kar, us bharpoor ajr ki wajah se jo tujhe milega, aur is tarah ke woh, jo paak hai, tere neik aamaal ki wajah se tujh se raazi hai.”
29: “Ab mere neik bandon ke saath shaamil ho ja,”
30: “aur un ke saath meri jannat mein daakhil ho ja, jo maine un ke liye tayyar ki hai.”
